about: The evangelium of the formulary “Nativity of the Lord — Mass at Dawn” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: At that time the shepherds said one to another: Let us go over to Bethlehem and see this word that hath come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us. They came with haste and found Mary and Joseph, and the Infant laid in a manger. And seeing, they understood the word that had been spoken to them concerning this Child. All who heard wondered at those things that were told them by the shepherds. But Mary kept all these words, pondering them in her heart. The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things they had heard and seen, as it had been told unto them.
